privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: This text is a draft prepared by the developer for the prototype. The final version must be written and approved by MHSV®'s legal counsel before going into production.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: MHSV® — International Centre for Development and Transition, Geneva, Switzerland. Full details are given in the Contact section.

sections.title: Data processed
sections.body: When you use the contact form, we process the data you provide: first name, last name, email address, phone number (optional), profile or organisation, subject and message content.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
sections.body: This data is used solely to respond to your enquiry. Processing is based on your consent, given when you submit the form.

sections.title: Recipients
sections.body: Messages are sent to the MHSV® contact address and handled by authorised people within the organisation. No data is sold or passed on for advertising purposes.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Messages are kept for as long as necessary to handle the enquiry, then deleted or archived in line with applicable obligations.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This site sets no tracking cookies and uses no third-party analytics. Fonts are hosted on our own servers, and no requests are made to external services when you visit.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), you have the right to access, correct, delete and object to the processing of your data. You may withdraw your consent at any time by writing to us.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about data protection, write to us using the contact form or at the address given in the Contact section.
